title: Jenny AI joins the creative app directory
summary:
A community-directory day: Jenny AI joined the listings, Elixpo projects got clearer credit, and a duplicate entry disappeared.

Jenny AI was added to the README and website directory. The chatbot and character-creation app uses Pollinations for image generation and vision, and lists text-to-speech and speech-to-text features.

The README and website project list now credit Ayushman Bhattacharya for Pollinations Feed and the Elixpo Art Chrome Extension. The README also groups the Elixpo projects and describes Feed by its realtime bento-grid interface.

The project listings gained Jenny AI and lost a duplicate Chrome Extension entry, making the directory a little easier to browse.
